question: Who has been selected for the Lokmanya Tilak National Award 2026?
detail:
- National Security Adviser (NSA) **Ajit Doval** was selected for the **Lokmanya Tilak National Award 2026** for his outstanding contribution to national security, counter-terrorism and border security.
- The **Lokmanya Tilak National Award** is a civilian award presented since **1983** by the **Tilak Smarak Mandir Trust, Pune (Maharashtra)** for excellence in nation-building and social service.
- The award includes **₹1 lakh**, a citation and a memento.
- **Ajit Doval:** born 1945, Garhwal (Uttarakhand); a **1968-batch IPS** (Kerala cadre); NSA since **30 May 2014**; awarded the **Kirti Chakra (1989)**.

question: Which country ranks first in the world in terms of cotton cultivation on the basis of area (cotton acreage)?
detail:
- **India** ranks **first in the world in cotton acreage** (area under cotton cultivation), while it is **second** in cotton production and consumption.
- Cotton is also called India's **'White Gold'**.
- India contributes about **19%** of global cotton production; in **FY 2024–25** it exported cotton worth **USD 11.49 billion**, about 3.37% of global cotton exports.
- The government released reports and the **Mission for Cotton Productivity** — a 5-year scheme approved by the Cabinet on **5 May 2026** with an outlay of **₹5,659.22 crore** to boost cotton yield, quality and farmer income.

question: The Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026 will amend which Act?
options: Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act, 1971
detail:
- Union Home Minister **Amit Shah** proposed to introduce the **Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026** in the Rajya Sabha.
- It aims to give the National Song **'Vande Mataram'** the same legal protection as the National Anthem (Jana Gana Mana) under the **Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act, 1971**.
- Deliberately obstructing the singing of the National Anthem or National Song, or disrupting an assembly, will be punishable with **up to 3 years' imprisonment**, fine, or both.
- The 1971 Act makes insulting the **National Flag, Constitution and National Anthem** a criminal offence, and is linked to the **Fundamental Duty under Article 51A(a)**.
- **Exam facts:** Vande Mataram was composed by **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay in 1875** and featured in his 1882 novel **Anandamath**.

question: Which is Bihar's first completed River Linking Project?
detail:
- Bihar Deputy CM **Samrat Chaudhary** inaugurated the **68.80 km Belwa–Minapur Link Channel (Belwadhar)** in Sheohar — **Bihar's first completed river-interlinking project**, built at a cost of **₹130.88 crore**.
- It links the **Bagmati river to the Burhi Gandak river**, diverting surplus flood water to reduce flood intensity in North Bihar.
- It runs from **Belwa Ghat in Sheohar district to Minapur in Muzaffarpur**, part of the Bagmati–Budhi Gandak interlinking and flood-management project.
- **Water diversion capacity — 50,000 cusecs**; **additional irrigation — 1.35 lakh hectares**.
- **Bagmati** originates in the **Shivapuri Hills, Nepal** (length ~589 km), enters India at Sitamarhi, and joins the **Kosi**; the **Burhi Gandak** originates in West Champaran and joins the **Ganga**.

question: When is World Brain Health Day celebrated every year?
detail:
- **World Brain Health Day** is observed every year on **22 July**.
- It is celebrated by the **World Federation of Neurology (WFN)** to raise awareness about brain health.
- The **2026 theme** is **'Brain Health – Access for All'**.
- The day was first observed in **2014**.
- **WFN** is a non-profit organisation working in brain health and neurology; formed **July 1957**, headquartered in **London, United Kingdom**.

question: India's first AI-powered Bird Sanctuary will be developed at which place?
detail:
- The **Maharashtra** government announced India's first **AI-powered Bird Sanctuary** at the **Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary** in Mumbai.
- The project, named **Bhandup Bird Park**, is approved at **₹45 crore** over about **20.09 hectares**.
- **AI** will be used for real-time tracking of birds, species identification, and data analysis of bird numbers and movement to improve conservation.
- Facilities like a **mangrove nature trail, observation towers and viewing decks** will also promote eco-tourism.
- **Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary:** established **6 August 2015**; Maharashtra's second marine sanctuary and a **Ramsar Site (2022)**; home to Greater and Lesser Flamingos and about 200 bird species.

question: Which country became the 123rd member of the WTO Fisheries Subsidies Agreement (AFS)?
detail:
- **India** deposited its **Instrument of Acceptance** for the **WTO Fisheries Subsidies Agreement (AFS)**, becoming its **123rd member**.
- The document was handed to WTO Director-General **Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala**.
- The **AFS** was adopted at the **12th WTO Ministerial Conference (MC12), Geneva, June 2022** and came into force on **15 September 2025**.
- It is the WTO's first agreement aimed at curbing subsidies that encourage **Illegal, Unreported and Unregulated (IUU) fishing**, overfishing and depleted fish stocks.
- **Benefits for India:** better protection for traditional and small-scale fishers and curbs on harmful subsidies to large industrial fishing fleets.
- **WTO:** established **1 January 1995**, HQ **Geneva**, replaced GATT (1947).

question: Recently, researchers discovered five new species of the Allographa genus of lichen-forming fungi in which region?
detail:
- Researchers discovered **5 new species** of the **Allographa** genus of lichen-forming fungi in the **Western Ghats**.
- **Allographa** belongs to the family **Graphidaceae**, with over 200 species worldwide; in India it is found mainly in the Western Ghats.
- Lichens are highly sensitive to pollution, climate change and habitat changes, so they are treated as an important **bioindicator of ecosystem health**.
- **Lichens** are formed by a **symbiotic association** between a fungus and a photosynthetic partner (algae or cyanobacteria).
- India has about **2,900 lichen species**; the **Eastern Himalaya and Western Ghats** are its richest lichen-diversity regions.

question: Which Articles of the Constitution provide the basis for the Right to Protest in India?
detail:
- The **Right to Protest** came into discussion after clashes between protesters and police during the **'Sansad Chalo' march**.
- Peaceful protest in India is a fundamental right under **Article 19**, subject to reasonable restrictions.
- **Article 19(1)(a)** — freedom of speech and expression; **Article 19(1)(b)** — right to assemble peaceably and without arms.
- **Articles 19(2) & 19(3)** allow reasonable restrictions in the interest of public order, security, sovereignty, decency and morality.
- **Regulation:** **Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)** — earlier **Section 144 of the CrPC** — lets a District/Sub-Divisional Magistrate impose restrictions when law and order is threatened.

question: Which company has launched India's first UPI-enabled Meal Card?
detail:
- **EnKash** launched **India's first UPI-enabled Meal Card**, becoming the first company to offer this facility.
- Employees can **scan a UPI QR code** to pay directly at authorised food and grocery merchants.
- A **meal card** is given by companies to employees for meal allowance; earlier it worked only at select outlets, but is now linked to **UPI**.
- **Tax benefit:** up to **₹200 per meal** is tax-free under revised Income-Tax provisions — up to about **₹1,05,600 per year** in tax-free benefits.
- **EnKash** is a full-stack business payments and spend-management platform; founded **2017**, HQ **Mumbai**.
